name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when buying a luxury home?

mainEntity.name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when buying a luxury home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common pitfalls when buying a luxury home include insufficient due diligence, underestimating ongoing maintenance costs, and overlooking potential legal or zoning restrictions. Not thoroughly vetting the property's history, especially in older, historic areas like Coconut Grove or Coral Gables, can also lead to issues. It's crucial to work with professionals who can identify these concerns early. We emphasize comprehensive property research and disclosures to help clients avoid unforeseen complications and ensure a sound investment.
